definition.name: delete_event
definition.description: Delete a calendar event by id. Always call list_events first to confirm the id, and never delete more than one event per call.

definition.name: list_events
definition.description: List calendar events between two dates, ordered by start time.

start.description: Start of the range as an ISO 8601 date

end.description: End of the range as an ISO 8601 date
